disclaimer: Every number in DayZero is an illustrative assumption for a fictional township inspired by a 30-acre mixed-use masterplan. Nothing here is real project data from any developer.

sources.cost: Illustrative order-of-magnitude estimate, not a quote

model.label: Slowdown in unshaded midday heat (heat-sensitive personas)
A 'direct' route is at most this × straight-line distance
Crossing-detour barrier when route exceeds this × straight line
…and is at least this much longer than a direct route
Smallest change counted as better / worse
Smallest step-free detour counted as a barrier

rules.label: Journey time
rules.value: distance ÷ speed + crossing waits + queue waits + rest-stop penalties

rules.label: No-seating barrier
rules.value: Continuous stretch with no seat longer than the persona's comfortable limit (150 m for Uncle Tan)

rules.label: Seated path
rules.value: A path with ≥ 1 seat per 100 m never exceeds the limit; seats at a place reset the stretch

rules.label: Step-free gap
rules.value: The step-free route is longer than the route with steps (wheelchair users cannot use steps at all)

rules.label: Footbridge stairs
rules.value: Each flight of stairs counted as ≈ 40 m of equivalent walking

rules.label: Time at stops
rules.value: Shown separately; not counted as journey time (except inside a deadline window)

rules.label: Time returned per year
rules.value: Minutes saved per day × days a year the routine happens

rules.label: Accessibility gain
rules.value: Net minutes per day no longer lost to barriers, summed over all personas

rules.label: Map scale
rules.value: 1 map unit = 1 m; layout is fictional
